verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding agent that works on your own projects (gh-1). It can run write commands under a permission model (docs-3, gh-6) and handles git workflows such as branching, worktrees, commits and PRs (gh-5), so the requested maintenance tasks are plausible but only implied. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of writing tests, fixing lint errors, resolving merge conflicts, and updating dependencies; hands-on corroboration of any of these tasks.
